other_conditions: Applicant must be listed in the SECC (Socio-Economic Caste Census) database
Applicant must be interested in establishing a goat‑rearing unit for self‑employment
benefits_summary: The State Government funds 90% (₹63,000) of the ₹70,000 cost to set up a goat‑rearing unit of 10 female goats and 1 male goat, with the beneficiary contributing the remaining 10% (₹7,000).
